body:
User asked (verbatim, via the lead):
  THE OWNER: "do all however better auth is doing". Build: 1. per-enrolment issuer; 2. skipVerificationOnEnable (opt-in); 3. get-totp-uri guarded by password and a fresh sign-in; 4. verify without issuing a session (disableSession) plus a Go CheckCode-style call with the same rate limits and lockout; 5. view-backup-codes as an opt-in encrypted storage mode (key derived from auth.WithSecret under a fixed KeyLabel), viewing needs a fresh sign-in; 6-7. table-rename and field-rename rows set to partial.

Context:
  Files: plugin/twofactor, docs/plugins/twofactor.md, docsi/plans/compare/better-auth/factors.md (Two-factor section).

Acceptance:
  Every Two-factor row ✅ or 🟡 with reasons starting '👤 Owner decided (2026-10-06): '; task check green; integration on three engines; staticcheck; task cover; report to main.
title: Two-factor parity with better-auth (r15-twofactor)
